transcript.text: I need to flag a critical update. The signed musicians agreement for this repertoire, which I confirmed this morning, requires exactly 24 players — not the 18 currently listed on the production sheet. Additionally, the agreement mandates a 20-minute break from 8:15 PM to 8:35 PM. I haven't entered this amendment in the production sheet yet, so we need to update it and contract 6 additional musicians before tonight.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rigging issue. My certified rigging inspection found that the overhead points may carry no more than 450 kg in total, but the two planned scenic frames and their rigging hardware would weigh 510 kg — that's 60 kg over the certified limit. One frame weighing 240 kg is within the certified limit, so we can safely suspend one frame but not both. I have not yet filed the revised load plan, but I will need to revise the rigging plan and file a revised load plan reflecting a single-frame configuration.
